1. Add a corner at each click. A line follows the pointer to show the next side.
2. Close the polygon on the first corner, with a double-click or with Enter.
3. Fill the polygon with the nonzero winding rule, with anti-aliasing.
4. Feather the shape when the feather setting is above 0.
5. Combine it with the current selection by the mode.
